Q.name: Starcall
Q.title: Template:Data Soraka/Starcall
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Starcall|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Soraka
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Starcall.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls down a star upon the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area before landing after {{pp|type=target range|0.25 to 1 for 16|50 to 800}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. 
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|85 to 225}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}}}
|description2 = If this hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, star dust returns to '''Soraka''', granting her ''Rejuvenation'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. While '''Soraka''' has ''Rejuvenation'', casting ''{{ai|Astral Infusion|Soraka}}'' will also grant ''Rejuvenation'' to the target for the same duration.
|description3 = {{sbc|Rejuvenation}}: {{tip|Heal}} every {{fd|0.2}} seconds and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration.
|leveling3    = {{st|Total Heal|{{ap|60 to 120}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Heal per Tick|{{ap|60/12 to 120/12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/12}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|8 to 4}}
|cost         = {{ap|45 to 65}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 800
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 265
|targeting    = Location
|damagetype   = Magic
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|projectile   = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Starcall'' counts as hitting even if it gets blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, granting ''Rejuvenation''.
* Both the initial hit and the ''Rejuvenation'' projectile can be {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}.
* ''Rejuvenation'' heals over 12 ticks, with the first 4 each healing for about 15% of the heal, the next 4 ticks for about {{fd|5.5}}% each, and the last 4 for about {{fd|4.5}}% each.
* ''Rejuvenation'' won't be granted to '''Soraka''' and she won't be able to make use of the health cost reduction on {{ai|Astral Infusion|Soraka}} until the projectile gets to her, but she is able to ''Rejuvenate'' allies as soon as the target is hit.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Soraka}} calls down a star upon the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slows}} enemies hit. If this hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, the star dust returns to '''Soraka''' to grant her ''Rejuvenation'' for a short time.
|blurb2      = While '''Soraka''' has ''Rejuvenation'', ''{{ai|Astral Infusion|Soraka}}'' will also grant ''Rejuvenation'' to the target ally.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Rejuvenation}}: The target continually {{tip|heals}} over time and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration.
}}

W.name: Astral Infusion
W.title: Template:Data Soraka/Astral Infusion
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Astral Infusion|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Soraka
|skill        = W
|icon         = Astral Infusion.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Soraka}} consumes a portion of {{as|her '''maximum''' health}} to {{tip|heal}} the target allied champion.
|blurb2      = If this is cast while under ''{{ai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}}'', the {{as|health cost}} is reduced.
|blurb4      = ''Astral Infusion'' cannot be cast if '''Soraka's''' {{as|'''current''' health}} is too low.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' {{tip|heals}} the target allied champion.
|leveling     = {{st|Heal|{{ap|90 to 170}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description2 =  If cast while under ''{{ai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}}'', the {{as|health cost}} will be reduced by a percentage.
|leveling2    = {{st|Health Cost Reduction|{{ap|80 to 100}}%|Reduced Health Cost|{{as|{{ap|2 to 0}}% of '''maximum''' health}}}}
|description3 =  ''Astral Infusion'' cannot be cast if '''Soraka''' is below {{as|{{sti|5% of her '''maximum''' health}}}}.
|cooldown     = {{ap|6 to 2}}
|cost         = {{as|10%|health}}
|costtype     = {{as|'''Maximum''' Health}} + {{ap|40 to 60}} Mana
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 550
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Allies / Self
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = False
|notes        = 
* ''Astral Infusion'' can also be targeted on allied {{tip|clone|decoys}}.
* ''Astral Infusion'' can be cast even if '''Soraka''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost while above {{as|{{sti|health|5% of her '''maximum''' health}}}}.
** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Astral Infusion'' will not reduce '''Soraka's''' health below {{as|1|hp}}.
* {{ii|Spirit Visage}} will only increase the health donated to allies if the target ally possesses it, although owning it ''will'' boost the heal that '''Soraka''' receives from {{ai|Starcall|Soraka}} and {{ai|Wish|Soraka}}.
* ''Astral Infusion's'' effects occur before the cast time.
* ''Astral Infusion'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
}}

R.name: Wish
R.title: Template:Data Soraka/Wish
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Wish|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Soraka
|skill        = R
|icon         = Wish.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Soraka}} calls upon the stars, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and all allied {{tip|champions}}, regardless of distance. The healing is increased on targets {{as|at low health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls upon the stars, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and all allied champions, increased by 50% on targets {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Heal|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Increased Heal|{{ap|150*1.5 to 350*1.5}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|150 to 120}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|effect radius= Global
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|affects      = Allies
|damagetype   = 
|spelleffects = 
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = 
|notes        = 
* Due to several character stats needing to be recalculated each time a character spawns, casting ''Wish'' immediately upon respawning will cause its cooldown to be unaffected by ability haste, and the healing will not be increased by '''Soraka's''' {{as|ability power}}. {{bug}}
* {{tip|Untargetable|Untargetability}} does not invalidate the targeting of the heal.
* ''Wish'' will not credit '''Soraka''' for [[assist]]ing in a [[kill|champion kill]] if the target ally is at full health.
* ''Wish'' will apply heal effects (such as {{ri|Summon Aery}}) prioritizing targets based on the ''Spawn ID'', which is the order in which units were added to an ongoing game. For {{tip|champions}}, this is the order they appear in from left to right in the loading screen.
* ''Wish's'' effects occur before the cast time.
* ''Wish'' will apply to units that are affected by '''Mordekaiser''''s R even if '''Soraka''' is not in the same realm.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Soraka_Original_R_0.ogg}} ''"Stars hear me!"''
}}
